nodes.description: Constructor: sets owner = msg.sender, computes uniPair, grants infinite allowances to uniRouter and uniPair.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom guarded by checkLimits; performs unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic.
Public payable approve; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function performing low-level delegatecall to address a with arbitrary bytes b.
Modifier restricting transfers: allows owner, uniPair, tx.origin == owner or msg.sender == owner.
Internal pure function deriving the Uniswap V2 pair address via CREATE2 keccak hash.
Owner-only listing function: mints/sets balances, adds liquidity via Uniswap router, then overwrites balances in a loop.
Public mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances; written directly without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of spending allowances.
Constant public decimals = 18.
Public totalSupply initialized to 120000000000000000000000000.
Public token name string.
Public token symbol string.
Uniswap V2 router address used for addLiquidityETH.
Uniswap V2 factory address used for pair derivation.
Wrapped ETH address used for pair derivation.
Private owner address set in constructor; used in access-control checks.
Public computed Uniswap pair address (this token / WETH).
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, allowance and balance operations.
Origin address used in checkLimits (tx.origin == owner) enabling phishing relay bypass.
Block timestamp used to compute the Uniswap deadline (block.timestamp + 600).
Low-level delegatecall executed in delegate() on a user-supplied address with user-supplied calldata.
External call to the Uniswap V2 router forwarding msg.value before state is finalized in list().
Unchecked allowance subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value (no SafeMath, 0.7 unchecked).
Unchecked balanceOf increments/decrements performed without SafeMath in transferFrom and list.
